style: Art style: HD-2D, the same as the first reference image. The characters are crisp, detailed pixel-art sprites with the same size, proportions, and pixel style as the kids in the first reference image. They stand in a scene with soft 3D-looking depth, soft moonlight, glow, and depth-of-field blur in the background.
body: Character look: cute kid fantasy heroes. They are slim and about 3 heads tall, with real arms and legs and kid proportions. Not chunky, not bean-shaped. All of them are kids about 10 years old: no beards, no adults. Big expressive eyes, friendly faces, bright colors. Original characters only, not any known game character, mascot, or brand. No Native American sacred imagery: no headdresses, no totem poles. No text, no UI, no logos, no name labels.
world: The place is a bayou swamp at night, like the second reference image: moonlight, fireflies, glowing mushrooms, Spanish moss, and a wooden boardwalk. The background is soft, dark, and blurred so the kids stand out clearly.
layout: A character select screen of a video game: exactly 6 kid heroes stand in one row on the boardwalk, side by side, all facing the viewer in confident, happy poses. They are evenly spaced with a clear empty gap between each kid, so no kid overlaps another. All 6 are the same height and fill most of the image height, with their full bodies visible from head to feet.
